name: review-completed
description: Records the structured outcome of a code review that has finished at some stage of the development workflow.
record_when: Record this immediately after a code review reaches a terminal state at any stage of the workflow (spec, design, implementation, pre-merge, post-merge, or release), whether the review was performed by the agent itself, a peer, an automated tool, or an external reviewer. Record it once per review run, at the moment the verdict is final, before any remediation work begins. Do not record it while the review is still in progress, and do not record one entry for multiple independent review runs - create a separate entry per run.

properties.name: stage
properties.description: The workflow stage at which this review was conducted.

properties.name: reviewType
properties.description: Who or what performed the review, distinguishing self-review, human peer review, static tooling, another LLM agent, or an external party.

properties.name: reviewer
properties.description: Identifier of the reviewing entity (person, tool name, or agent run id); use an explicit not-applicable marker if the reviewer is genuinely anonymous or unknown.

properties.name: reviewerModel
properties.description: Model identifier used when the reviewer was an LLM agent; use an explicit not-applicable marker when the reviewer was human or non-LLM tooling.

properties.name: artifactRef
properties.description: Reference to the artifact under review (pull request, commit, changeset, design document, or file path).

properties.name: artifactRevision
properties.description: The exact immutable revision of the artifact that was reviewed, such as a commit SHA or document version, so the verdict is pinned to what was actually seen.

properties.name: criteriaRef
properties.description: Reference to the checklist, rubric, or standard the review was measured against.

properties.name: completedAt
properties.description: When the review reached its terminal verdict.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: Wall-clock time spent performing the review, from startedAt to completedAt; use an explicit not-applicable marker if timing was not captured.

properties.name: outcome
properties.description: The final verdict of the review.

properties.name: maxSeverity
properties.description: The highest severity among all findings raised; use "none" when no findings were raised.

properties.name: findingsCount
properties.description: Total number of findings raised by the review, including non-blocking ones.

properties.name: blockingFindingsCount
properties.description: Number of findings that must be resolved before the artifact can advance.

properties.name: reworkRequired
properties.description: Whether the artifact must be modified before it can proceed past this stage.

properties.name: summary
properties.description: Concise narrative of what was reviewed, the reasoning behind the verdict, and the substance of the findings; use an explicit not-applicable marker only if the review genuinely produced no substantive content.

properties.name: followUpRef
properties.description: Reference to a follow-up issue or task created to address non-blocking findings; omit when none were created.
